name: Isobel
description: An angel of the Flight of Alabaster who joined Avacyn's rampage and was slain by humans.

description_citations.text: "Church of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Isobel, driven mad, joins Avacyn's rampage and is slain by the humans she once protected.
timeline.quote: Later driven to madness, Isobel joined Avacyn's rampage against the people of Innistrad and was consequently slain by the humans she once protected.
